title: 浮吊大型橋段吊裝~Floating-crane erection of major bridge segments
focus: 以吊索幾何、動態放大、浮體穩定與天候窗口控制，把千噸級預製橋段從駁船安全吊上橋墩~Sling geometry, dynamic amplification, floating stability and weather windows that bring thousand-tonne prefabricated segments safely from barge to pier
summary: 從岸上預製、水上運送、整段吊裝的工法邏輯出發，計算吊索力、擺動週期與動態放大，再處理吊耳承壓、構件吊裝狀態受力、浮吊錨泊、落位時潮汐與吃水變化，接著以吊鉤荷重與重心量測、天候窗口與預報係數驗證，最後處理吊孔封填、吊耳移除後的疲勞與交接紀錄，並以聯邦大橋的 Svanen 雙體浮吊、舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段與新 Tappan Zee 橋的剪腿式浮吊為案例。~Starting from the logic of prefabricating on shore, transporting over water and lifting whole segments, compute sling forces, swing periods and dynamic amplification, then handle lug bearing, the lifted-state behaviour of members, crane-barge mooring and tide and draft changes at set-down, verify with hook-load and centre-of-gravity measurements, weather windows and forecast factors, and finally treat lifting-hole sealing, fatigue after lug removal and handover records, with the Svanen catamaran at Confederation Bridge and the shear-leg crane at the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge east span and the new Tappan Zee crossing as cases.

units.anchor: 吊索與吊梁~Slings and spreader beam
units.title: 浮吊工法的系統與吊索傳力~System logic and sling load path
units.mechanism: 跨海或跨河橋梁的大型構件（主梁、落入跨、墩座、鋼箱梁節段）可以在岸上預製場以工廠條件完成，再由駁船運到橋位，或由浮吊直接吊著航行，最後整段吊放到橋墩或臨時支撐上。這把海上作業時間由數週縮短為數小時，但構件在吊裝期間的支承條件與設計狀態完全不同：重量經吊耳、吊索、吊梁傳到吊鉤，吊索的傾角會在構件內產生水平壓力，吊點位置也決定構件內的彎矩。吊梁的作用是讓吊索接近垂直，減少這種附加水平力。~Large members of sea and river crossings, such as main girders, drop-in spans, pier bases and steel box segments, can be completed under factory conditions in an onshore yard, carried to site by barge or by the floating crane itself, and lifted whole onto piers or temporary supports. This cuts offshore work from weeks to hours, but during the lift the member's support conditions are entirely different from its design state: weight passes through lugs, slings and a spreader beam to the hook, inclined slings induce horizontal compression in the member, and lift-point positions set its bending moments. A spreader beam keeps slings near vertical to reduce this added horizontal force.
units.model: 構件重 W = 15,000 kN，4 條吊索平均受力，吊索與水平夾角 θ = 60° 時 T = W/(4 sin θ) = 15,000/(4×0.866) ≈ 4,330 kN，每條水平分力 T cos θ ≈ 2,165 kN；若夾角降為 45°，T ≈ 5,303 kN、水平分力 3,750 kN，增加約 73%。數值為教學假設。~For a member W = 15,000 kN on 4 equally loaded slings at θ = 60° to the horizontal, T = W/(4 sin θ) = 15,000/(4×0.866) ≈ 4,330 kN with a horizontal component T cos θ ≈ 2,165 kN each; at 45°, T ≈ 5,303 kN and the horizontal component is 3,750 kN, about 73% more. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 吊裝計畫須附吊具配置圖：吊點座標、吊索長度與等級、卸扣與吊梁容量、吊索角度與每條受力，由吊裝工程師計算並經第三方審查；構件設計者另以吊裝狀態檢核構件內力，包括吊索水平分力造成的局部壓力。~The lift plan must include a rigging arrangement drawing with lift-point coordinates, sling lengths and grades, shackle and spreader capacities, sling angles and individual forces, calculated by the lifting engineer and checked by a third party; the member designer separately checks internal forces in the lifted state, including local compression from sling horizontal components.
units.failure: 吊索長度製作誤差使四點受力不均，一條吊索承受遠超計算值的力而斷裂，構件傾斜墜落；吊索角度過小又沒有吊梁，水平分力把構件的翼板壓屈或使吊耳根部撕裂。~Fabrication errors in sling length leave the four points unevenly loaded so one sling carries far more than calculated and breaks, tilting and dropping the member; too shallow a sling angle without a spreader lets the horizontal components buckle a flange or tear a lug from its base.
units.misconception: 只要吊索總容量大於構件重量，吊索角度與長度就無關緊要。~As long as total sling capacity exceeds member weight, sling angles and lengths do not matter.
units.practice: 吊具配置圖、吊索證書與檢驗紀錄是吊裝前的停留點文件，任何現場改變（換吊索、改吊點）都要重新計算並經吊裝工程師簽認；吊索須有唯一編號以追蹤使用次數。~The rigging drawing, sling certificates and inspection records are hold-point documents before lifting; any site change, such as a substitute sling or moved lift point, needs recalculation signed by the lifting engineer, and every sling has a unique number to track its use.

units.anchor: 吊物擺動週期~Pendulum period of the suspended load
units.title: 海況、擺動與動態放大~Sea state, swing and dynamic amplification
units.mechanism: 浮吊與陸上起重機最大的不同，是整個起重機本身漂浮在水上：波浪使船體縱搖、橫搖與起伏，吊臂頂端的運動被放大，吊物像單擺一樣擺動，吊索力也隨之忽大忽小。海事作業標準以動態放大係數把這些效應加到靜重上，係數隨吊物重量與海況而定；而吊物擺動週期若與波浪週期接近，就可能共振。因此大型橋段吊裝多選在遮蔽水域、低波高且波浪週期遠離擺動週期的天候窗口進行，並以拉索（tag line）或導向裝置控制擺動。~The great difference between a floating crane and a land crane is that the whole crane floats: waves pitch, roll and heave the hull, the boom tip amplifies these motions, the load swings like a pendulum and sling forces fluctuate. Marine-operation standards add these effects to the static weight through a dynamic amplification factor that depends on lifted weight and sea state, and if the load's swing period approaches the wave period, resonance can occur. Major bridge segments are therefore usually lifted in sheltered water, in weather windows with low wave height and wave periods far from the swing period, with tag lines or guide devices to control swing.
units.model: 單擺週期 T = 2π√(L/g)。吊索有效長度 L = 30 m：T = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11.0 s，與長週期湧浪接近；縮短到 15 m 時 T ≈ 7.8 s。若波浪尖峰週期約 10 至 12 s，30 m 吊索的配置須重新評估或改在更平靜的時段作業。數值為教學假設。~Pendulum period T = 2π√(L/g). With an effective sling length L = 30 m, T = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11.0 s, close to long-period swell; shortening to 15 m gives T ≈ 7.8 s. If the peak wave period is about 10 to 12 s, the 30 m rigging must be reconsidered or the lift moved to a calmer window. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以浮吊的運動反應資料（RAO）配合預報的波高與週期，估算吊臂頂端運動與吊索動態力，選定動態放大係數並納入吊裝計算；吊裝當天以船上運動感測器與波浪資料確認實際海況在限值內。~Use the crane vessel's motion response data (RAOs) with forecast wave height and period to estimate boom-tip motion and dynamic sling forces, select the dynamic amplification factor and include it in the lift calculation; on the day, confirm with onboard motion sensors and wave data that the actual sea state is within limits.
units.failure: 只看風速而忽略長週期湧浪，吊物在接近墩頂時開始大幅擺動並撞擊墩帽或已完成的構件，造成構件破損或吊索瞬間超載；在吊物擺動中強行落位，可能使支承或臨時支撐受衝擊損壞。~Watching only wind speed and ignoring long-period swell lets the load start swinging violently near the pier top and strike the cap or completed members, damaging them or overloading slings momentarily; forcing a set-down while the load swings can damage bearings or temporary supports by impact.
units.misconception: 浮吊吊裝只要風小就可以進行，波浪對吊物影響不大。~A floating-crane lift can proceed whenever wind is light; waves hardly affect the load.
units.practice: 吊裝計畫應明列作業限值（波高、波浪週期、風速、流速）與其來源，並由海事保證或第三方審查；現場以導向架與拉索控制擺動，任何人員不得在吊物下方或擺動範圍內停留。~The lift plan must list operational limits for wave height, wave period, wind speed and current with their basis, reviewed by a marine warranty surveyor or third party; on site, guide frames and tag lines control swing, and no one may stand beneath the load or within its swing zone.

units.anchor: 吊耳與銷孔承壓~Lifting lug and pin bearing
units.title: 吊耳設計與吊點局部受力~Lug design and local forces at lift points
units.mechanism: 鋼構件常以焊接吊耳吊裝，混凝土構件則用預埋吊環、預埋螺棒或貫穿孔加吊桿。吊耳把集中的吊索力傳入構件：銷孔周圍承受承壓與撕裂，吊耳根部焊縫承受拉力、剪力與彎矩，構件腹板或橫隔梁則必須把這股力分散開。吊耳設計要考慮吊索可能的偏角（平面外力），並以包含動態放大的設計荷載檢核；吊耳焊縫須全數做非破壞檢測，因為一個吊耳失效就可能讓整件構件失控。~Steel members are usually lifted by welded lugs, concrete members by cast-in loops, cast-in threaded bars or through-holes with lifting rods. A lug transfers a concentrated sling force into the member: the pinhole sees bearing and tear-out, the lug's root weld sees tension, shear and bending, and the member's web or diaphragm must spread the force. Lug design must allow for possible out-of-plane sling angles and be checked with design loads including dynamic amplification; all lug welds need non-destructive testing, because one failed lug can make the whole member uncontrollable.
units.model: 單一吊耳力 T = 4,330 kN 乘動態放大 1.10 得 4,763 kN。銷徑 d = 200 mm、吊耳板厚 t = 80 mm，承壓應力 σ = 4,763,000/(200×80) ≈ 298 MPa；以 S355 鋼 1.5f_y ≈ 532 MPa 為承壓上限，利用率約 0.56。數值為教學假設。~A single lug force T = 4,330 kN times a 1.10 dynamic factor gives 4,763 kN. With pin diameter d = 200 mm and lug thickness t = 80 mm, bearing stress σ = 4,763,000/(200×80) ≈ 298 MPa; taking 1.5f_y ≈ 532 MPa for S355 steel as the bearing limit, utilisation is about 0.56. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 吊耳製作後檢查孔徑、孔位、板厚與銷配合間隙，根部焊縫做超音波與磁粉檢測並保存報告；混凝土構件的預埋吊具須有出廠證明與拉拔試驗資料，澆置時確認位置與保護層，吊裝前確認混凝土強度達到吊裝要求。~After fabrication, check hole diameter, position, plate thickness and pin clearance, test root welds by ultrasonic and magnetic particle methods and keep the reports; cast-in lifting devices in concrete members need certificates and pull-out test data, their position and cover confirmed at casting, and concrete strength confirmed before lifting.
units.failure: 吊耳只以垂直力設計，實際吊索有 10° 以上的平面外偏角，吊耳根部在側向彎矩下開裂；混凝土構件在強度未達時吊裝，預埋吊具被拔出，構件局部崩落。~A lug designed only for vertical force but loaded with more than 10° of out-of-plane sling angle cracks at its root under lateral bending; lifting a concrete member before it reaches strength pulls a cast-in device out and spalls the member locally.
units.misconception: 吊耳只在吊裝時用幾小時，設計可以比永久構件寬鬆。~Lugs are used for only a few hours, so they can be designed less strictly than permanent members.
units.practice: 吊耳與預埋吊具屬於吊裝安全的關鍵構件，須由吊裝工程師設計、構件設計者確認其對永久構件的影響；不得重複使用未經檢查的吊耳，焊接與檢測紀錄隨構件編號歸檔。~Lugs and cast-in lifting devices are safety-critical: designed by the lifting engineer and checked by the member designer for their effect on the permanent member; uninspected lugs are never reused, and welding and testing records are filed under the member number.

units.anchor: 吊裝狀態彎矩~Bending in the lifted state
units.title: 長構件的吊點位置與吊裝狀態受力~Lift-point positions and lifted-state forces in long members
units.mechanism: 一根百餘公尺的主梁或鋼箱梁節段在吊裝時只由兩到四個吊點支撐，構件內力與營運時的連續或懸臂狀態都不同。吊點位置直接決定吊裝彎矩：兩點吊時，若吊點位於距兩端約 0.207 倍構件長處，跨中正彎矩與吊點負彎矩大小相等，峰值最小。細長鋼梁在吊裝時還可能側向扭轉挫屈，必須加臨時側向支撐或採用吊梁使吊點力保持垂直；預力混凝土構件則要檢查吊點處頂緣的拉應力。~A girder or steel box segment over a hundred metres long is supported by only two to four lift points while hanging, so its internal forces differ from both its continuous and cantilever service states. Lift-point positions directly set the lifting moments: for a two-point lift, placing the points about 0.207 times the member length from each end makes the midspan sagging moment equal to the hogging moment at the lift points and minimises the peak. Slender steel girders can also buckle laterally and torsionally while hanging, needing temporary lateral bracing or a spreader beam to keep lift forces vertical, and prestressed concrete members need checks of top-fibre tension at the lift points.
units.model: 構件長 L = 120 m、w = 60 kN/m，兩點吊於距端 a = 0.207L ≈ 24.9 m：吊點負彎矩 wa²/2 ≈ 18,530 kN·m，跨中正彎矩 w(L − 2a)²/8 − wa²/2 也約 18,530 kN·m，只有兩端簡支時 wL²/8 = 108,000 kN·m 的約 17%。數值為教學假設。~For a member L = 120 m with w = 60 kN/m lifted at two points a = 0.207L ≈ 24.9 m from the ends, the hogging moment at the lift points wa²/2 ≈ 18,530 kN·m equals the midspan sagging moment w(L − 2a)²/8 − wa²/2 of about 18,530 kN·m, only about 17% of the 108,000 kN·m wL²/8 for end supports. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 構件設計者以吊裝計畫的實際吊點與動態放大檢核應力與穩定，必要時規定臨時加勁或側撐；吊裝前在關鍵斷面貼應變計，頂離支架數公分後暫停，比較量測與計算，確認無誤再繼續。~The member designer checks stresses and stability for the actual lift points and dynamic factor in the lift plan, specifying temporary stiffening or bracing if needed; before lifting, gauge critical sections, pause after raising the member a few centimetres off its supports, compare measured and calculated values and proceed only if they agree.
units.failure: 吊點被移到構件端部附近以配合吊具，跨中彎矩倍增，預力混凝土主梁底緣開裂或鋼梁下翼板屈服；細長鋼梁未加側撐，吊起後側向扭轉，吊具失衡。~Moving lift points near the ends to suit the rigging multiplies midspan moment, cracking a prestressed girder soffit or yielding a steel bottom flange; a slender steel girder without bracing twists laterally once lifted and unbalances the rigging.
units.misconception: 構件能承受營運荷載，就一定能承受自己的吊裝狀態。~A member that can carry service loads can always carry its own lifting state.
units.practice: 構件施工圖應標示允許吊點範圍、吊裝狀態所需的臨時加勁與最小混凝土強度，吊裝計畫不得超出這些範圍；變更須經構件設計者書面同意。~Member shop drawings should mark allowed lift-point zones, temporary stiffening required for the lifted state and the minimum concrete strength, and the lift plan must stay within them; changes need the member designer's written consent.

units.anchor: 浮吊錨泊與定位~Crane-barge mooring and positioning
units.title: 浮吊錨泊、流力與定位~Mooring, current forces and positioning
units.mechanism: 浮吊靠近橋墩作業時，需以錨纜、定位樁或動力定位系統保持位置，抵抗潮流、風與波浪的漂移力。船體側向迎流時受力遠大於船首迎流，所以定位方向要配合潮流，並把作業安排在潮流轉向的平潮時段。吊重時船體吃水與傾斜改變，錨纜張力隨之變化；靠近橋墩還要考慮淺水與海底管線，錨的位置與拋錨路徑須事先申請與標示。~When working beside a pier, a crane barge must hold position with mooring lines, spuds or dynamic positioning against drift forces from current, wind and waves. Beam-on current loads are much larger than bow-on loads, so the vessel is oriented to the current and operations are scheduled around slack water when the tide turns. Lifting changes draft and heel, and mooring tensions change with them; near piers, shallow water and seabed pipelines must be considered, and anchor positions and anchoring paths must be permitted and marked in advance.
units.model: 流力 F = ½ρC_dAV²。ρ = 1,025 kg/m³、C_d = 1.0、流速 1.5 m/s：船首迎流投影面積 30 m × 7 m = 210 m² 時 F ≈ 0.5×1,025×1.0×210×1.5² ≈ 242 kN；側向迎流 117 m × 7 m = 819 m² 時 F ≈ 944 kN，約為船首迎流的 3.9 倍。數值為教學假設。~Current force F = ½ρC_dAV². With ρ = 1,025 kg/m³, C_d = 1.0 and 1.5 m/s current, a bow-on projected area of 30 m × 7 m = 210 m² gives F ≈ 0.5×1,025×1.0×210×1.5² ≈ 242 kN; beam-on, 117 m × 7 m = 819 m² gives F ≈ 944 kN, about 3.9 times as much. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 錨泊分析須列出各錨纜在設計流速、風速與吊重狀態下的張力，與錨的抓力和纜繩破斷力比較並保留安全係數；作業前確認錨位、測深與海底障礙調查，作業中監測錨纜張力與船位，偏移超過允許值即停止吊裝。~The mooring analysis lists line tensions under design current, wind and lifting conditions, compared with anchor holding capacity and line breaking strength with safety factors; before work confirm anchor positions, soundings and seabed obstruction surveys, and during work monitor line tensions and vessel position, stopping the lift if offset exceeds the limit.
units.failure: 在潮流最強時段作業，錨纜張力超過錨的抓力，浮吊拖錨漂移，吊物撞上橋墩；錨纜跨越航道或鉤到海底電纜，造成第三方損害與作業中斷。~Working at peak current lets line tensions exceed anchor holding so the crane drags anchors and drifts, swinging the load into the pier; lines crossing a fairway or snagging a seabed cable cause third-party damage and stop the work.
units.misconception: 浮吊很重，水流不可能推動它，所以不必特別錨泊。~A floating crane is so heavy that current cannot move it, so special mooring is unnecessary.
units.practice: 錨泊計畫須經港務或航政主管機關核准並發布航行公告，作業時間依潮汐表安排在平潮前後；船長、吊裝總指揮與錨泊監控人員的通訊與指揮權限事先明定。~The mooring plan must be approved by the port or maritime authority with a notice to mariners, and work is timed around slack water from tide tables; communications and command authority among the master, lift director and mooring watch are defined in advance.

units.anchor: 落位導向與荷重轉換~Set-down guides and load transfer
units.title: 落位對位、潮汐與吃水變化~Set-down alignment, tide and draft change
units.mechanism: 吊物到達橋墩上方後，先以導向架或擋塊做粗對位，再慢慢下放，使構件坐上臨時支撐、支承或已完成構件的接合面。浮吊在這個階段有兩個特殊問題：潮汐使船體持續升降，吊鉤高度隨之改變；荷重由吊鉤轉移到墩上時，船體吃水變淺而上浮，吊鉤也跟著上升，如果不同步放鉤，構件會被重新提起或受衝擊。因此落位要分級進行，每一級都確認構件已穩定坐上支撐、臨時固定完成，才逐步釋放吊鉤荷重。~Once over the pier, the load is roughly aligned by guide frames or stops and lowered slowly onto temporary supports, bearings or the joint face of completed members. A floating crane brings two particular problems at this stage: the tide keeps raising or lowering the hull and therefore the hook, and as load transfers from the hook to the pier the vessel's draft decreases so it rises and lifts the hook with it; unless the hook pays out in step, the member is lifted again or shocked. Set-down therefore proceeds in stages, each confirming that the member sits stably on its supports and is temporarily secured before more hook load is released.
units.model: 吊重 15,000 kN 完全轉移到墩上時，船體上浮 Δ = W/(ρgA_wp)。水線面積 117 m × 30 m = 3,510 m²：Δ = 15,000/(1.025×9.81×3,510) ≈ 0.43 m。另若潮位每小時變化 0.5 m，20 分鐘的落位期間又變化約 0.17 m。數值為教學假設。~When 15,000 kN transfers fully to the pier, the vessel rises Δ = W/(ρgA_wp). With a waterplane of 117 m × 30 m = 3,510 m², Δ = 15,000/(1.025×9.81×3,510) ≈ 0.43 m. If the tide changes 0.5 m per hour, a 20-minute set-down adds about 0.17 m more. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 落位前在墩頂設置量測標記與導向，吊鉤荷重以 25% 為一級釋放，每級量測構件高程、支撐壓縮與吊鉤荷重；臨時固定（栓接、楔塊或臨時預力）完成並經檢查後才完全卸鉤，所有讀值與時間記錄存檔。~Before set-down, fit survey marks and guides on the pier top; release hook load in steps of 25%, measuring member levels, support compression and hook load at each step; release the hook completely only after temporary fixings (bolts, wedges or temporary prestress) are completed and inspected, logging all readings with time.
units.failure: 一次放鉤到零，船體上浮又把吊鉤提起，構件在支撐上跳動，臨時支撐或支承受衝擊損壞；漲潮時未及時放鉤，吊索被拉緊，構件被拖離已對位的位置。~Releasing the hook to zero in one go lets the rising vessel lift it again so the member bounces on its supports, damaging temporary supports or bearings; failing to pay out on a rising tide tightens the slings and drags the member off its aligned position.
units.misconception: 浮吊落位與陸上起重機一樣，只要把吊鉤慢慢放下即可。~Setting down with a floating crane is just like a land crane: lower the hook slowly.
units.practice: 落位程序書須列出分級卸載比例、每級檢查項目、臨時固定方式、潮汐與吃水補償方法；完全卸鉤是停留點，由吊裝總指揮、構件設計代表與監造共同確認。~The set-down procedure must list unloading steps, checks at each step, temporary fixing methods and tide and draft compensation; full hook release is a hold point confirmed jointly by the lift director, the member designer's representative and the supervising engineer.

units.title: 吊重與重心的量測驗證~Measuring lifted weight and centre of gravity
units.mechanism: 吊裝計算的起點是構件重量與重心，但混凝土單位重、鋼筋量、預埋件、殘留模板與積水都會使實際重量偏離計算值。因此大型吊裝會在吊鉤或各吊索上安裝荷重計，頂離支架後先暫停，量測總重與各點分配，反算重心位置；若與計算差異超出預留的重量裕度，必須停止並重新評估吊具與起重機利用率。量得的數據也回饋給後續相同構件的吊裝計畫。~Lift calculations start from member weight and centre of gravity, but concrete unit weight, reinforcement, embedments, leftover formwork and trapped water all move the real weight away from calculation. Major lifts therefore fit load cells on the hook or each sling, pause just after lift-off, measure total weight and its distribution and back-calculate the centre of gravity; if the difference exceeds the weight contingency, the lift stops and rigging and crane utilisation are re-evaluated. The data also feed back into the plans for later identical members.
units.model: 兩組吊點相距 20 m，量得 R₁ = 7,800 kN、R₂ = 7,200 kN，總重 15,000 kN，重心距第一組 x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m；設計值 10.0 m，偏差 0.4 m，構件吊起後會向第一組一側傾斜，須調整吊索長度或吊點。數值為教學假設。~With two lift-point groups 20 m apart reading R₁ = 7,800 kN and R₂ = 7,200 kN, the total is 15,000 kN and the centre of gravity lies x = 7,200×20/15,000 = 9.6 m from the first group; against a design value of 10.0 m, the 0.4 m offset will tilt the hanging member towards the first group, so sling lengths or lift points must be adjusted. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 荷重計須有有效校正並在吊裝前歸零；頂離支架約 100 至 200 mm 後保持數分鐘，記錄穩定讀值並與計算重量、重心比較，差異在預設範圍內才續吊。量測結果附於吊裝紀錄，並更新同型構件的重量資料庫。~Load cells need valid calibration and are zeroed before the lift; after raising the member about 100 to 200 mm off its supports, hold for a few minutes, record steady readings and compare with calculated weight and centre of gravity, continuing only if differences are within the preset range. Results are attached to the lift record and update the weight database for similar members.
units.failure: 構件內殘留模板與積水使實際重量比計算多數個百分點，起重機在最大工作半徑下超載警報，吊物已離開駁船無法安全放回；重心偏移未發現，構件在空中傾斜並撞擊吊臂或駁船結構。~Leftover formwork and trapped water make the member several percent heavier than calculated, the crane's overload alarm sounds at maximum radius with the load already off the barge and no safe place to set it back; an undetected centre-of-gravity offset tilts the member in the air into the boom or barge structure.
units.misconception: 構件重量由圖面計算即可，不需要在吊裝時量測。~Member weight can be taken from the drawings; it need not be measured at the lift.
units.practice: 吊裝計畫應訂定重量裕度（例如 5%）與重心容許偏差，並規定頂離暫停量測為必要步驟；吊裝前清除構件上的雜物與積水並由專人檢查簽認。~The lift plan should set a weight contingency, for example 5%, and a centre-of-gravity tolerance, and make the lift-off pause and measurement mandatory; before lifting, debris and water are removed from the member and checked and signed off by a designated person.

units.anchor: 天候窗口與預報係數~Weather window and forecast factor
units.title: 天候窗口、預報不確定與作業限值~Weather windows, forecast uncertainty and operational limits
units.mechanism: 浮吊吊裝是一次不能中途隨意中斷的作業：吊物一旦離開駁船，就必須完成落位與臨時固定。因此決定是否開始，要看整個作業期間（含應變時間）的天候預報，而不是開始時的天氣。海事作業標準以作業限值乘上小於 1 的預報係數，作為預報值的上限，來涵蓋預報誤差；同時要把地面或海面 10 m 的風速換算到吊臂高度，因為高處風速較大，吊物與吊臂承受的風力也較大。~A floating-crane lift cannot be stopped casually halfway: once the load leaves the barge, set-down and temporary fixing must be completed. Whether to start therefore depends on the forecast for the whole operation including contingency time, not the weather at the start. Marine-operation standards multiply the operational limit by a forecast factor below 1 to set the maximum acceptable forecast value, covering forecast error; the 10 m wind speed must also be converted to boom height, where it is stronger and loads the boom and suspended member more.
units.model: 風速剖面 V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11。V₁₀ = 10 m/s 時，90 m 吊臂高度 V₉₀ ≈ 10×9^0.11 ≈ 12.7 m/s。若起重機在吊臂高度的作業限值 15 m/s、預報係數 0.8，預報值須 ≤ 12 m/s，換算回 10 m 高度約 12/1.27 ≈ 9.4 m/s。數值為教學假設。~Wind profile V_z = V₁₀·(z/10)^0.11. For V₁₀ = 10 m/s, the speed at a 90 m boom height is V₉₀ ≈ 10×9^0.11 ≈ 12.7 m/s. With a crane limit of 15 m/s at boom height and a forecast factor of 0.8, the forecast must not exceed 12 m/s, about 12/1.27 ≈ 9.4 m/s at 10 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 作業前訂定計畫作業時間與應變時間，取得涵蓋整段時間的專業海象氣象預報；作業前會議確認預報值在折減後的限值內，作業中以吊臂頂與船上的風速計、波浪資料持續監測，接近限值即啟動預先規劃的中止或安全放置方案。~Before the lift, define the planned operation time and contingency, obtain a specialist marine forecast covering the whole period, and confirm at the pre-lift meeting that forecasts are within the reduced limits; during the lift monitor boom-tip and deck anemometers and wave data continuously, triggering the pre-planned abort or safe-set-down option near the limits.
units.failure: 只依開始時的好天氣起吊，未考慮下午鋒面接近，吊物在空中時風速超過限值，只能冒險落位或吊著等待；以地面風速判斷而忽略吊臂高度的風，吊物旋轉失控。~Lifting on a fine morning without regard to an approaching afternoon front leaves the load in the air when wind exceeds the limit, forcing a risky set-down or a hanging wait; judging by ground-level wind and ignoring wind at boom height lets the load spin out of control.
units.misconception: 只要起吊當時風平浪靜，整個吊裝就是安全的。~If it is calm when the lift starts, the whole operation is safe.
units.practice: 吊裝的開始決定是停留點：由吊裝總指揮、船長、海事保證檢驗員與業主代表依預報與限值共同簽認；中止條件與吊物安全放置位置事先規劃，不在現場臨時決定。~The decision to start is a hold point signed jointly by the lift director, master, marine warranty surveyor and owner's representative against forecasts and limits; abort criteria and safe set-down locations are planned beforehand, not improvised on site.

units.anchor: 吊孔封填與保護層~Lifting-hole sealing and cover
units.title: 吊裝孔洞與接合的海洋環境耐久~Marine durability of lifting holes and joints
units.mechanism: 混凝土構件為了吊裝而留下的貫穿孔、預埋吊具凹槽與臨時預力錨座，在吊裝後都要封填。這些位置常位於海水噴濺區，若封填材料的緻密度低於母體混凝土，或與母體界面脫開，氯離子會更快到達鋼筋。聯邦大橋這類冰海環境中的橋梁，還要承受凍融與冰撞。耐久設計因此必須把吊裝細部當作永久構件的一部分，規定封填材料、表面處理與檢查方法。~Through-holes, recesses for cast-in lifting devices and temporary prestressing anchors left in concrete members by the lift must all be sealed afterwards. They often lie in the splash zone, and if the filling is less dense than the parent concrete or debonds from it, chlorides reach the reinforcement sooner. Bridges in icy seas such as Confederation Bridge also face freeze–thaw and ice impact. Durability design must therefore treat lifting details as part of the permanent member, specifying filling materials, surface preparation and inspection methods.
units.model: Fick 擴散 C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]。以 C/C_s = 0.1 為鋼筋起鏽門檻時 x/(2√(Dt)) ≈ 1.163，t = [x/(2×1.163)]²/D。保護層 x = 75 mm：母體 D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s 時 t ≈ 33 年；封填材料 D = 5×10⁻¹² m²/s 時 t ≈ 6.6 年。數值為教學假設。~Fick diffusion C/C_s = erfc[x/(2√(Dt))]. Taking C/C_s = 0.1 as the corrosion threshold gives x/(2√(Dt)) ≈ 1.163 and t = [x/(2×1.163)]²/D. For 75 mm cover, parent concrete with D = 1×10⁻¹² m²/s reaches it in about 33 years, while a filling with D = 5×10⁻¹² m²/s does so in about 6.6 years. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 封填前檢查孔壁粗糙度與清潔，封填材料做擴散係數或電阻率試驗並與母體比較；封填後以敲擊與拉拔試驗確認黏結，並在交接時把每一處封填位置、材料與日期列表。~Before filling, check hole-surface roughness and cleanliness and test the filling's diffusion coefficient or resistivity against the parent concrete; afterwards confirm bond by sounding and pull-off tests, and tabulate every sealed location, material and date at handover.
units.failure: 吊裝後以一般砂漿草率封填吊孔，數年後封填塊周圍出現鏽水與裂縫，鋼筋在吊點附近局部腐蝕；臨時預力錨座未封閉，鋼棒端部腐蝕並使周圍混凝土剝落。~Filling lifting holes hastily with ordinary mortar lets rust stains and cracks appear around the patches within a few years, with local corrosion near the lift points; unsealed temporary prestress anchorages corrode at bar ends and spall the surrounding concrete.
units.misconception: 吊孔只是施工用的臨時孔，用任何砂漿填平即可。~Lifting holes are temporary, so any mortar will do to fill them.
units.practice: 構件圖說應把吊孔封填列為永久細部，規定材料性能、施工方法與檢查頻率；封填作業屬檢驗停留點，完成並驗收後才可進行塗裝或防護層施工。~Member drawings should treat lifting-hole sealing as a permanent detail with specified material performance, method and inspection frequency; sealing is an inspection hold point, accepted before any coating or protective layer is applied.

units.anchor: 吊耳移除與疲勞細部~Lug removal and fatigue details
units.title: 吊耳移除、疲勞與吊裝紀錄交接~Lug removal, fatigue and handover of lift records
units.mechanism: 鋼構件上的吊耳在吊裝後通常要切除，但切除位置若留下殘根、切割缺口或焊縫未磨平，就等於在主梁受拉翼板上留下一個附加物細部，疲勞類別大幅下降。正確的做法是在離母材一段距離處切除，再磨平並做磁粉檢測；若吊耳位於低應力區且設計允許保留，也要確認其焊縫細部的疲勞類別。交接時應把每一個吊耳的位置、處理方式與檢測結果，以及吊裝紀錄（重量、重心、天候、荷重讀值）一併移交。~Lugs on steel members are usually cut off after the lift, but a stub, gouge or unground weld left at the cut equals an attachment detail on a tension flange, sharply lowering its fatigue category. The correct method is to cut a short distance from the parent metal, grind flush and test by magnetic particle; if a lug in a low-stress zone may stay by design, its weld detail's fatigue category must still be confirmed. Handover should include every lug's position, treatment and test result, together with the lift records of weight, centre of gravity, weather and load readings.
units.model: S–N 曲線 m = 3 時壽命比 = (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³。母材平滑板類別 160 MPa，若殘留附加物使類別降為 80 MPa，同一應力幅下壽命為 (80/160)³ = 1/8。數值為教學假設。~With an m = 3 S–N curve, the life ratio is (Δσ_C1/Δσ_C2)³. A plain plate of category 160 MPa reduced to category 80 MPa by a remaining attachment has (80/160)³ = 1/8 of the life at the same stress range. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 切除吊耳後以目視與磁粉檢測確認無裂紋、表面已磨平且沒有咬邊，量測研磨後板厚不低於設計值；吊裝紀錄逐件整理，包括吊裝計畫版本、量測重量與重心、天候紀錄、落位量測與臨時固定檢查，由業主驗收。~After lug removal, confirm by visual and magnetic-particle inspection that there are no cracks, the surface is ground flush without undercut, and measured plate thickness after grinding is not below design; compile lift records member by member, including plan revision, measured weight and centre of gravity, weather logs, set-down surveys and temporary-fixing inspections, accepted by the owner.
units.failure: 吊耳以火焰切割後未研磨，受拉翼板上留下的缺口在數年交通荷載後成為疲勞裂縫起點；吊裝紀錄散失，日後檢查發現構件局部變形，無法判斷是吊裝衝擊還是營運造成。~A flame-cut lug left unground leaves a notch on a tension flange that becomes a fatigue crack origin after years of traffic; with lift records lost, local distortion found at a later inspection cannot be attributed to lifting impact or service.
units.misconception: 吊耳切除後的殘根不影響結構，只是外觀問題。~A lug stub left after removal is only cosmetic and does not affect the structure.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含吊裝計畫與修訂紀錄、吊具與吊耳檢測報告、吊耳處理清單、量測與天候紀錄、封填紀錄，並標示需在首次定期檢查特別檢視的位置。~Handover documents should include lift plans with revisions, rigging and lug test reports, the lug treatment list, measurement and weather logs and sealing records, and mark the locations to be examined closely at the first routine inspection.

example: 吊裝規劃練習：一件預製橋段靜重 15,000 kN，重量裕度 5%，吊具與吊梁 400 kN，動態放大係數 1.10，則吊鉤設計荷重 = (15,000×1.05 + 400)×1.10 = (15,750 + 400)×1.10 ≈ 17,765 kN，約 17,765/9.81 ≈ 1,811 t。若浮吊在所需工作半徑的額定容量為 2,000 t，利用率約 0.91；但若因墩旁水深不足必須退後，工作半徑加大使額定容量降為 1,800 t，利用率升為約 1.01，超過容許值。可行對策包括：浚深或改用定位樁縮短半徑、改用較輕的吊梁、把構件分成較輕的兩段，或改在流速較低的平潮時段以較小動態放大係數作業（需經海事保證審查）。另以 30 m 吊索的擺動週期約 11 s 檢查是否接近預報的波浪週期。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際工程的吊裝計畫。~Lift-planning exercise: a prefabricated segment has a static weight of 15,000 kN, a 5% weight contingency, 400 kN of rigging and spreader, and a dynamic amplification factor of 1.10, so the design hook load is (15,000×1.05 + 400)×1.10 = (15,750 + 400)×1.10 ≈ 17,765 kN, about 17,765/9.81 ≈ 1,811 t. If the crane's rated capacity at the required radius is 2,000 t, utilisation is about 0.91; but if shallow water beside the pier forces the vessel to stand off, the larger radius drops capacity to 1,800 t and utilisation rises to about 1.01, beyond the allowable. Options include dredging or using spuds to shorten the radius, a lighter spreader, splitting the member into two lighter pieces, or working at slack water with a smaller dynamic factor subject to marine warranty review. The 30 m rigging's swing period of about 11 s should also be checked against the forecast wave period. Values are teaching assumptions, not the lift plan of any real project.
history: 大型浮吊讓跨海橋梁可以把整段構件在岸上預製再一次吊放。荷蘭建造的雙體重吊船 Svanen 原為丹麥大貝爾特橋建造，之後在 1994 至 1996 年為加拿大聯邦大橋吊放墩座、主梁與落入跨等大型預製構件，這座長 12.9 km、主跨 250 m 的橋於 1997 年 5 月 31 日通車，之後 Svanen 又參與厄勒海峽大橋。2009 年建成的剪腿式浮吊 Left Coast Lifter 額定約 1,700 t，在 2010 至 2011 年為舊金山—奧克蘭海灣大橋東段吊放 28 段箱梁橋面，2014 年改名 I Lift NY，在 2015 至 2018 年參與紐約新 Tappan Zee 橋（州長 Mario M. Cuomo 橋）的建造，之後並協助拆除舊橋。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Large floating cranes let sea crossings prefabricate whole members on shore and set them in one lift. The Dutch-built catamaran heavy-lift vessel Svanen, originally built for Denmark's Great Belt crossing, placed pier bases, main girders and drop-in spans for Canada's Confederation Bridge between 1994 and 1996; the 12.9 km bridge with 250 m main spans opened on 31 May 1997, and Svanen went on to the Øresund Bridge. The shear-leg crane barge Left Coast Lifter, built in 2009 and rated about 1,700 t, placed 28 box-girder deck sections for the San Francisco–Oakland Bay Bridge east span in 2010–2011, then as I Lift NY helped build New York's new Tappan Zee crossing, the Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge, between 2015 and 2018 and afterwards helped dismantle the old bridge. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 聯邦大橋全長 12.9 km，是跨越冰封水域最長的橋，1997 年 5 月 31 日通車~Confederation Bridge is 12.9 km long, the world's longest bridge over ice-covered water, and opened on 31 May 1997
聯邦大橋 44 座主墩間距 250 m，構件於 1994 年秋至 1996 年秋由 Svanen 吊放~Confederation Bridge's 44 main piers are 250 m apart, with components placed by Svanen from autumn 1994 to autumn 1996

Left Coast Lifter 剪腿式浮吊船長約 117 m、寬約 30 m，額定約 1,873 美噸（約 1,700 t），吊臂約 100 m~The Left Coast Lifter shear-leg barge is about 117 m long and 30 m wide, rated about 1,873 US tons (about 1,700 t), with an about 100 m boom
Left Coast Lifter 於 2010 年 2 月至 2011 年 10 月為海灣大橋東段吊放 28 段箱梁橋面~Left Coast Lifter placed 28 box-girder deck sections for the Bay Bridge east span between February 2010 and October 2011

I Lift NY 於 2015 年 4 月首吊，2016 年 10 月完成西行橋最後一段主梁，2018 年 4 月完成東行橋最後一吊~I Lift NY made its first lift in April 2015, set the last westbound girder in October 2016 and the last eastbound lift in April 2018
州長 Mario M. Cuomo 橋為約 3 英里長的雙幅斜張橋，2018 年全面通車~The Governor Mario M. Cuomo Bridge is an about 3 mile twin-span cable-stayed crossing, fully opened in 2018
